title: Result too large to be represented.
summary: A subclass of ArithmeticError, Exception, BaseException.

title: Check for overload signatures that cannot match.
summary: Warn if an @overload variant can never be matched, because an earlier overload has a wider signature. For example, this can happen if the two overloads accept the same parameters and each parameter on the first overload has the same type or a wider type than the corresponding parameter on the second overload. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check that overloaded functions don't overlap.
summary: Warn if multiple @overload variants overlap in potentially unsafe ways. This guards against the following situation. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check validity of overrides.
summary: Mypy checks that an overridden method or attribute is compatible with the base class. A method in a subclass must accept all arguments that the base class method accepts, and the return type must conform to the return type in the base class (Liskov substitution principle). mypy enables this error code by default.
